About.title: Veteran-owned, and personal about it
About.subtitle: Limpios started from one idea: bring the attention to detail I learned in the service, plus real local care, to every home and business we clean.

story.title: Our story
body: Hi, I'm Papo. I started Limpios after I got out of the military (TODO confirm with Papo) and moved my family to the Clermont area. I'd been cleaning houses and offices on the side for friends, and people kept telling me the same thing: the crews they'd hired before would cut corners, show up late, or just stop answering the phone.

That bugged me. In the service you show up on time, you do the job all the way, and you own it when something's off. So I built Limpios to run like that. Same crew, eco products that won't choke out your house, and a checklist we actually follow.
These days it's still a small, family-run, bilingual team, and I'm usually out on jobs myself. We keep Central Florida clean one house at a time, and I like it that way.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.body: Give people their weekends back with cleaning that's reliable, eco-friendly, and done right the first time. When you book Limpios, you're handing your keys to neighbors who actually care how the job turns out.

eco.title: Our eco-friendly commitment
eco.body: We use eco-friendly, low-odor products that are hard on dirt and easy on your family, your pets and the planet (TODO confirm specific brands with Papo). A healthier clean shouldn't cost you the air in your own home.

pricing.a: It depends on the size of the place, what kind of shape it's in, and how often you book. Standard home cleans start around $120 and deep cleans around $200. The quote itself is always free and built for your space, so there are no surprises on the day.

eco.q: Are your products eco-friendly and safe for pets and kids?
eco.a: Yes. We use eco-friendly, low-odor products that are tough on dirt but gentle on your family, your pets and the air inside. If anyone in the house has allergies or sensitivities, tell us and we'll adjust.

supplies.q: Do I need to provide supplies or equipment?
supplies.a: No. We bring our own HEPA vacuums and professional, eco-friendly supplies (TODO confirm with Papo). If you'd rather we use a specific product you already keep at home, that's no problem.

pets.q: What should I do with my pets during the cleaning?
pets.a: Your pets are welcome to stay right where they are. Just give us a heads-up about them when you book so the team can work around them and keep them comfortable.

satisfaction.q: What if I'm not happy with the cleaning?
satisfaction.a: Then we make it right. If anything's off, call us within 24 hours and we'll come back and re-clean it, free. That's the deal, no arguing about it.

bilingual.q: Do you offer service in Spanish?
bilingual.a: Claro que sí. Limpios is fully bilingual, so we're glad to help you in English or Spanish, whether that's by phone, by message, or in person.

insured.a: Yes. Limpios is licensed and insured, and everyone on the team is vetted and background-checked before they ever set foot in your home.

booking.q: How do I book or get a quote?
booking.a: Fill out the online quote in about two minutes, or just call us. Either way we'll confirm the details and lock in a time that works for you.
